Notice to all Seafarers, fishers, Retired Seafarers, Cadets, Families of personnel, Shipowners, Operators, Manning Agents, Training Providers and Maritime Welfare Personnel.

This notice should be read in conjunction with MIN 732 (M+F) Amendment 1, which remains relevant to the subject matter.

MIN 734 (M+F) Amendment 2 replaces MIN 734 (M+F) Amendment 1.

Amendment 2 updates section 5.

This MIN expires 1st May 2028
